# Incident Report: Overnight Refrigeration Failure — Rosemont Bakery & Café

**Report ID:** RB-2024-017
**Date of Incident:** March 12, 2024
**Date of Report:** March 18, 2024
**Prepared by:** Facilities & Operations Review Team
**Distribution:** Owner, Store Manager, Head Baker, Facilities Contractor, Insurance Carrier

---

## 1. Summary

At approximately 2:40 a.m. on March 12, 2024, the walk-in cooler at Rosemont Bakery & Café ceased maintaining temperature following a compressor fault. The failure went undetected until 4:55 a.m., when the opening baker arrived and noticed condensation on the cooler door and an ambient reading of 52°F (11°C) inside the unit. All temperature-sensitive inventory — including custards, cream-filled pastries, mousse cakes, fresh dairy, and egg products — was discarded per food safety guidelines. No product reached customers. Estimated loss: $3,400 in inventory plus one day of reduced pastry sales. No one was injured.

This report reconstructs the event, examines contributing factors across people, process, and equipment, and recommends changes to reduce the likelihood of recurrence.
